<!-- ═══════════════ TRAINING ═══════════════ -->
<section>
  <div class="section__head">
    <div>
      <div class="section__label">Training</div>
      <div class="section__title">Learn emissivity measurement from the people who <em>do it</em>.</div>
    </div>
    <a href="/contribute/suggest-event.html" class="section__link">Announce a course &rarr;</a>
  </div>

  <p class="inner-page" style="max-width:52rem; line-height:1.7; color:var(--ink-soft);">
    Courses, tutorials, thematic schools and hands-on workshops on thermal radiation,
    radiative properties and emissivity measurement, offered by the institutions on
    the <a href="/network/index.html">research map</a> and by the networks they belong
    to. Entries are dated and linked to the organiser's page; upcoming ones are
    highlighted. Announcements reach the editorial board through the
    <a href="/contribute/suggest-event.html">event form</a> or by email.
  </p>

  <div class="training-kinds">
    <div class="training-kind">
      <h3>Schools</h3>
      <p>Week-long thematic schools with lectures and practical sessions, such as the TAMARYS school on radiative transfer.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="training-kind">
      <h3>Courses</h3>
      <p>Short courses and modules on emissometry, radiometry and infrared spectroscopy, in person or online.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="training-kind">
      <h3>Tutorials</h3>
      <p>Tutorial sessions attached to conferences and workshops, including the <a href="/ir-empower/index.html">IR-EMPOWER</a> laboratory tours.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="training-kind">
      <h3>Workshops</h3>
      <p>Hands-on workshops on instruments, uncertainty budgets, data formats and the <a href="/data/ekhi.html">EKHI</a> database.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="section__head">
    <div>
      <div class="section__label">Calendar</div>
      <div class="section__title">Schools, courses and tutorials, newest <em>first</em>.</div>
    </div>
    <a href="/files/ical/emissivity-conferences.ics" class="section__link">iCal feed &rarr;</a>
  </div>
</section>
